# 闭包的五个层次：供给闭包在影响闭包之内，影响闭包与所及闭包在系统之内，每个包含都可以是严格的，影响闭包与所及闭包方向相反；一个共同条件使系统成为整体 / Five levels of closure: the feeding closure lies within the influence closure, and the influence and reach closures within the system, each inclusion possibly strict, the influence and reach closures pointing in opposite directions; one common condition makes the system the whole

## 主张 Claim

区域对一个关系封闭（ClosedUnder），是指成员与之有此关系者都是成员；g 在 f 对此关系的闭包之内（WithinClosure），是指含 f 的每个封闭区域都含 g。闭包自反、可传递，含 f 与之有此关系者，随关系增大，在对称关系下对称，闭包之内的不与闭包之外的有此关系（WithinClosure.refl、trans、of_rel、mono、symm、not_rel），闭包本身封闭（closedUnder_withinClosure），所以是含 f 的最小封闭区域；它恰是 Becoming.Bridge 中从 f 这一个种子出发的种子—边闭包（withinClosure_iff_closure）。P40 的供给闭包是对在某步被供给的闭包（Flow.FedFrom、Flow.withinFeeding_iff、Flow.fedClosed_iff）。形成受另一个影响（Flow.AffectedBy），是指后者与前者在某步所依存的条件交换（Web.DependsOn、Flow.Exchanges）；影响闭包（Flow.WithinInfluence）是对受影响的闭包，即能影响形成的；所及闭包（Flow.Affects、Flow.WithinReach）是对影响的闭包，即形成的交换能逐环影响的。形成参与一个条件（Flow.TakesPart），是指依存于它或与它交换；两个形成都参与一个条件，即共享它（Flow.Shares）；系统（Flow.WithinSystem）是对共享的闭包，是类（Flow.shares_symm、Flow.WithinSystem.symm）。供给闭包在影响闭包之内（Flow.affectedBy_of_fedFrom、Flow.withinInfluence_of_withinFeeding），影响闭包与所及闭包都在系统之内（Flow.shares_of_affectedBy、Flow.withinSystem_of_withinInfluence、Flow.withinSystem_of_withinReach），系统对影响封闭（Flow.withinSystem_closed）。每个包含都可以是严格的，影响闭包与所及闭包方向相反：营养级联 Trophic 中，两个流都平衡，只有活跃者给予与取用，活动需要支持；狼群不向任何条件给予，在森林的供给闭包之外、影响闭包之内，远处的形成在森林的系统之外（Trophic.mediates、Trophic.near_closed）；Clearing 中来源在清除者的供给闭包之内，栖居者在其影响闭包之外、系统之内（Clearing.alongDependence_closed、Clearing.levels），清除者的所及闭包含栖居者、不含来源（Clearing.clearerReach_closed、Clearing.reach_middle），栖居者的所及闭包只含它自己（Clearing.reach_centred）；两个形成依存于一个没有任何东西与之交换的条件时，共享一个系统而彼此不影响（Static.shares_unaffected）。每个形成都参与一个条件时，每个系统都是整体（Flow.system_whole_of_common）；每个形成都依存于它并与它交换时，每个所及闭包都是整体（Flow.reach_whole_of_common）；在某步每个形成都需要它并向它给予时，每个供给闭包都是整体（Flow.feeding_whole_of_common），以各中心供给闭包为界的意义，即 P40 不用公理的路线，就是公理（Flow.feeding_unrestricted_of_common）；每个中心的系统都是整体时，以系统为界的意义就是公理（Flow.bounded_system_whole）。Clearing 是一个系统（Clearing.clearer_system、Clearing.system_whole）。不用前提，也不用 Lean 公理；Unrestricted 在这里只作为结论出现：某个有界的意义恰是它。 / A region is closed under a relation (ClosedUnder) when whatever a member bears the relation to is a member; g lies within f's closure under the relation (WithinClosure) when every closed region holding f holds g. The closure is reflexive and transitive, holds what f bears the relation to, grows with the relation, is symmetric under a symmetric relation, and nothing within it bears the relation to what lies beyond it (WithinClosure.refl, trans, of_rel, mono, symm, not_rel); it is itself closed (closedUnder_withinClosure), so it is the least closed region holding f; it is exactly the seed–edge closure of Becoming.Bridge from the one seed f (withinClosure_iff_closure). P40's feeding closure is the closure under being fed at some step (Flow.FedFrom, Flow.withinFeeding_iff, Flow.fedClosed_iff). A formation is affected by another (Flow.AffectedBy) when the other exchanges with a condition the first depends on at some step (Web.DependsOn, Flow.Exchanges); the influence closure (Flow.WithinInfluence) is the closure under being affected, what can affect the formation; the reach closure (Flow.Affects, Flow.WithinReach) is the closure under affecting, what the formation's exchange can affect, link by link. A formation takes part in a condition (Flow.TakesPart) when it depends on it or exchanges with it; two formations taking part in one condition share it (Flow.Shares); the system (Flow.WithinSystem) is the closure under sharing, a class (Flow.shares_symm, Flow.WithinSystem.symm). The feeding closure lies within the influence closure (Flow.affectedBy_of_fedFrom, Flow.withinInfluence_of_withinFeeding), the influence and reach closures lie within the system (Flow.shares_of_affectedBy, Flow.withinSystem_of_withinInfluence, Flow.withinSystem_of_withinReach), and the system is closed under affecting (Flow.withinSystem_closed). Each inclusion can be strict, and the influence and reach closures point in opposite directions. In Trophic, a trophic cascade, both flows balance, only active formations give and take, and activity needs support; the wolves give to nothing, lying beyond the forest's feeding closure and within its influence closure, and a formation far off lies beyond the forest's system (Trophic.mediates, Trophic.near_closed). In Clearing the source lies within the clearer's feeding closure and the dweller beyond its influence closure and within its system (Clearing.alongDependence_closed, Clearing.levels); the clearer's reach closure holds the dweller and not the source (Clearing.clearerReach_closed, Clearing.reach_middle), and the dweller's holds only itself (Clearing.reach_centred). Two formations depending on a condition that nothing exchanges with share a system and neither affects the other (Static.shares_unaffected). Where every formation takes part in one condition, every system is the whole (Flow.system_whole_of_common); where every formation depends on it and exchanges with it, every reach closure is (Flow.reach_whole_of_common); where at one step every formation requires it and gives to it, every feeding closure is (Flow.feeding_whole_of_common), and significance bounded by each center's feeding closure, P40's route without axiom, is the axiom (Flow.feeding_unrestricted_of_common); where each center's system is the whole, significance bounded by the system is the axiom (Flow.bounded_system_whole). Clearing is one system (Clearing.clearer_system, Clearing.system_whole). No premise and no Lean axiom is used; Unrestricted appears here only as a conclusion, that some bounded significance is exactly it.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 闭包、影响、共享与所及都是形成层面的：交换与依存各在某一步，不要求同一步，也不按时间先后；比较定理用按时间先后的 Flow.ReachesBefore。 / Closures, influence, sharing and reach are at the level of formations: the exchange and the dependence each hold at some step, not necessarily the same one, in any temporal order; the comparison theorems use Flow.ReachesBefore, which is ordered in time.
- Trophic、Static 与 Clearing 的结论：见证的流、网与依存（Trophic.flow、Trophic.web、Trophic.responsiveFlow、Trophic.responsiveWeb、Static.flow、Static.web、Clearing.flow、Clearing.web）。 / For the Trophic, Static and Clearing results: the witnesses' flows, webs and dependence (Trophic.flow, Trophic.web, Trophic.responsiveFlow, Trophic.responsiveWeb, Static.flow, Static.web, Clearing.flow, Clearing.web).
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren 的长远目标：“I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”；Ren 要求“pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”。Ren 的层级：“i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：影响闭包读一个形成自身的反馈在效果经他者的支持与活动传递时所能计入的；所及闭包读 Ren 中间的“the system that one is in”（P40 把供给闭包读作所在系统，这一读法撤回）；系统（对共享条件的闭包）界定每个效果，却不读那一层级：一个共同条件就使它成为整体，系统划分形成，没有嵌套与中心；“situational awareness”读作中心知道其部分在反馈之外所到达的。名称（ClosedUnder、WithinClosure、AffectedBy、WithinInfluence、Affects、WithinReach、TakesPart、Shares、WithinSystem、Reaches、ReachesBefore、DiffersBefore、Trophic 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选；营养级联是生态学用语。 / Ren's long-term objectives: “I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”; Ren asked to “pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”. Ren's levels: “i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): the influence closure reads what a formation's own feedback can register once effects pass through the support and activity of others; the reach closure reads Ren's intermediate “the system that one is in” (P40 read the feeding closure as the system one is in; that reading is withdrawn); the system, the closure under sharing a condition, bounds every effect but does not read that level: one common condition makes it the whole, and systems partition the formations, with no nesting and no center; “situational awareness” reads as a center knowing what its part reaches beyond its feedback. The names (ClosedUnder, WithinClosure, AffectedBy, WithinInfluence, Affects, WithinReach, TakesPart, Shares, WithinSystem, Reaches, ReachesBefore, DiffersBefore, Trophic and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard; trophic cascade is the ecological term.

闭包是形成层面的，不按时间先后，所以是可靠的上界，不是当下的关系；共同条件是布尔的，不度量耦合的强度，不把 Ren 的“highly entangled system”读作这一条件；所及闭包读“the system that one is in”是 AI 的读法，待 Ren；中心怎样表示其闭包没有建模；不含伦理谓词。 / The closures are at the level of formations and not ordered in time, so they are safe upper bounds, not present relations; the common condition is Boolean and does not measure the strength of coupling, and Ren's “highly entangled system” is not read as that condition; reading the reach closure as “the system that one is in” is the AI's reading, pending Ren; how a center represents its closure is not modelled; contains no ethical predicate.

- 系统不读一个中心所在的中间层级：每个形成都参与一个共同条件时它就是整体（Flow.system_whole_of_common，Clearing.system_whole）；共享不推出影响（Static.shares_unaffected）。 / The system does not read an intermediate level a center is in: wherever every formation takes part in one common condition it is the whole (Flow.system_whole_of_common, Clearing.system_whole); sharing does not give affecting (Static.shares_unaffected).
